# Security policy

Report security vulnerabilities affecting Hybrid or preferedev-operated infrastructure to
[security@ping.gg](mailto:security@ping.gg). Please do not disclose them publicly until we have had
a reasonable opportunity to investigate and remediate them.

See the [full security policy](https://hybrid.preferedev.xyz/security-policy) for reporting details, scope,
and safe harbor terms for good-faith research.
